DIAGNOSIS READY: Nephrotic Syndrome (likely Membranous Nephropathy).

I have reviewed the results you provided; your low albumin (1.8 mg/dL) and elevated creatinine (1.6 mg/dL) combined with significant weight loss and leg swelling are highly indicative of kidney disease.
